name: Kawakami Keiichirou
source:
A middle-aged man who ends up working and living at [Tsuru-Pa].

He is a former soldier who went to the U.S., enlisted in the U.S. military, and gained combat experience overseas, but was dishonorably discharged after assaulting a superior officer. He returned to Japan with fellow soldiers who had also been discharged.
After drifting from place to place, he sees an opportunity to make a home with his friends at a run-down amusement park—a vast, empty space with no visitors—and jumps at the job opening.

At first, he lived a carefree life, but as he ran short on daily expenses and grew hungry for excitement, he took it upon himself to improve operations.
While maintaining normal operations during the day, he organized horror events at night using existing attractions and hastily constructed mazes.
Word of mouth gradually increased foot traffic, and more young people began making the trip from the city, leading to a sharp rise in nighttime visitors in particular.
He began viewing female visitors—who were terrified and running in panic—as prey, attacking them to satisfy his craving for thrills.
